stage: M5 isolated candidate; production integration is M6

transport.protocol: MQTT 5 over WSS, normal certificate verification
transport.source_ip: actual socket peer; no payload, forwarding header or GROUP routing
transport.authorization: existing direct business access; independent original receiver enrollment proof
transport.isolation: separate business/gateway accounts for files and enrollment, no cross-tree delivery; anonymous disabled

upload.encoding: base64 of original bytes, never newline/BOM normalization
upload.progress: contiguous aligned offset, fsynced chunk then atomic manifest
upload.duplicates: identical offset/length/hash is idempotent; conflicting bytes rejected
upload.finish: assemble, verify all chunks and whole length/SHA256, fsync/rename before ready
upload.resume: explicit status query after reconnect/restart, same owner/IP and immutable intent
upload.cancellation: staging only; never rolls back a committed import/export or database transaction

download.source: saved original export or full archive; exact supplied SHA256
download.snapshot: server-owned immutable copy; original cleanup lock held while copying
download.verification: server verifies each stored chunk; host verifies final length/SHA256 including resumed prefix before commit
download.release: downloads.close removes generated payload only; keeps receipt; no automatic retention cleanup

business.data_invoke: verified application/json upload containing {method,body}; original M4 allowlist/DTO/epoch/CAS/previewDigest/confirmation/transaction/receipt semantics
business.large_reply: download_required with immutable JSON UTF-8 download descriptor, never truncation
business.storage: original unified SQLite; M4 business+audit+receipt same FULL transaction; file lifecycle follows original archive manifests
business.unknown: never replay file/domain writes; query operation and original domain status; database outcomes query original M4 operation
business.full_archive: original ZIP with consistent SQLite, all tables/rows and completed export inventory; staging and pairing material excluded

enrollment.proof: existing P-256 nonextractable key; SHA256 ECDSA P1363; exact original 8-line challenge
enrollment.key_namespace: original HTTPS :8802 origin | canonical simulated MAC; not WSS origin
enrollment.challenge: 30 seconds, original IP plus current M5 socket session, single use
enrollment.renewal: fresh signed challenge; original credential_id/receiver_id/MAC/CA/GROUP retained; 8-hour secret rotates
enrollment.secret: memory-only TLS response on own ephemeral enrollment reply topic; no retained, persisted Broker session, business DB, archive, log or generic write cache
enrollment.lost_response: new signed challenge; no enrollment response/secret replay cache
enrollment.fashe_lifecycle: original retry/backoff, expiry stop, channel state, ownership and auto-power rules unchanged

permanent_order: actual numeric GROUP ascending, CH ascending within GROUP, unknown last; GROUP is not identity
not_completed: M1-M5 cross-process session and revocation integration
remote FAshe copies and browser background/freeze validation
staging retention policy and host pending-operation UX
power-loss durability beyond verified process-crash/fsync boundaries
